clothing-import-announcement-title: Bulk import is now available for Clothing products
clothing-import-announcement-body: You can now add or update Clothing products in bulk using an Excel template. Download the sample file, fill in your product and variant details, add your images in a ZIP file, then upload both files for validation before importing.
clothing-import-history-help: Reopen a recent Clothing import job to review its status, errors, or report.
clothing-import-history-unavailable: Import history is not available from the backend yet.
clothing-import-no-history: No Clothing import jobs found for this shop yet.
clothing-import-step-workbook: Detailed steps to upload the bulk import
clothing-import-workbook-help: Follow these steps to prepare your Excel workbook and image ZIP. The preview step checks everything before any product is created or updated.
clothing-import-detailed-step-download: Download the latest bulk import template. Always start from a fresh template so category and dropdown values match the current catalog setup.
clothing-import-detailed-step-fill: Open the workbook and use the correct sheet for each product: Top Wear, Bottom Wear, or Outerwear. You may fill one sheet or multiple sheets in the same upload.
clothing-import-detailed-step-category: In each product row, choose the category from the Category dropdown in Excel. Use the dropdown value exactly as provided; do not type a custom category name.
clothing-import-detailed-step-required: Fill all required columns marked in the template. Required columns can be different for Top Wear, Bottom Wear, and Outerwear.
clothing-import-detailed-step-images: Enter image filenames in featured_image and gallery_images, then place those exact image files inside one ZIP file.
clothing-import-detailed-step-upload: Upload the completed Excel workbook and the image ZIP together.
clothing-import-detailed-step-preview: Review the validation preview, fix any errors in Excel, then confirm the import only when all rows are valid.
clothing-import-workbook-sheet-help: Add only this section's products here. Each row is one sellable variant, and the system checks the category, required fields, and dropdown values during preview.
clothing-import-rule-category-dropdown: Categories and fixed options are provided as Excel dropdowns by the backend. If the category you need is missing, download a fresh template or ask support to update the catalog categories.
clothing-import-rule-one-row: Use one row for each sellable variant. For example, the same T-shirt in sizes S, M, and L should be entered as three rows.
clothing-import-rule-parent-sku: Use the same parent_sku for variants that belong to the same product, and a unique sku for each sellable variant row.
clothing-import-rule-images: Supported image formats are jpg, jpeg, png, and webp. Each image must be under 5MB, and filenames in Excel must exactly match filenames inside the ZIP.
clothing-import-rule-row-limit: You can add up to 50 product rows in each sheet or tab.
clothing-import-rule-do-not-edit-templat: Do not rename sheets, change column headings, remove columns, or reorder columns in the Excel template.
clothing-import-rule-limits: The confirmed limits are 50 rows per sheet and 5MB per image. XLSX size and ZIP size limits are enforced by the backend during preview if configured.
clothing-import-template-help: Download the Excel workbook generated by the backend, then fill one row for each sellable variant in the correct segment sheet.
clothing-import-template-download-failed: Could not download the bulk import template.
clothing-import-template-not-available: Bulk import template is not available yet. The backend endpoint GET /api/imports/clothing/template may not be deployed.
clothing-import-upload-help: Upload the completed Excel file and one ZIP containing all referenced product images.
clothing-import-preview-warning: Products are not created or updated during preview. The import starts only after you confirm a valid preview.
clothing-import-desktop-warning: Bulk error review works best on a desktop or larger screen.
clothing-import-files-required: Please upload both the completed XLSX file and image ZIP file.
clothing-import-preview-failed: Could not preview the Clothing import.
clothing-import-report-download-failed: Could not download the Clothing import report.
clothing-import-commit-failed: Could not confirm the Clothing import.
clothing-import-completed: Import completed. Download the report or return to products to review the updated catalog.
clothing-import-failed: The import job failed. Download the report for details, fix the sheet, and preview again.
clothing-import-blocking-errors: Fix all row and group errors before confirming this import.
clothing-import-ready: Preview is valid. You can confirm the import now.
clothing-import-owner-only: Only store owners and administrators can import Clothing products.
